EDITION 2.2.0 / 02
Born in Dundee
An idea from Finella Gardens, Dundee, Scotland. A framework built to turn that idea into useful software.

FINELLA GARDENS
Dundee, Scotland.
Where the idea became a framework.
A name with a real beginning.
FINELLA > FNLLA
The name has a place
FNLLA takes its name from Finella Gardens in Dundee,
Scotland, where the idea originated and the
framework was first written. The shortened name
connects the product to its beginnings without
making a promise about its technical scope.
The people behind the product
Created & maintained by TechAyo.
techayo.co.uk
hello@techayo.co.uk
. Lead Developer / Product
Manager - Marcin Kordyaczny. Repeat the credits
consistently. TechAyo is the public-facing brand.
Keep the legal entity name in license notices, not
marketing credits.
A local origin. An open invitation.
Use the story as a human introduction, not as a
substitute for product evidence. The invitation is
practical: inspect the code, build an application and
contribute improvements. FNLLA is the product
name; Finella Gardens is its name origin.
